What does this app do?
It scans the apps installed on your phone and shows signs that are common in apps installed through ads (source, install time, risky permissions, and so on).

How to use it
When the phone is too slow to operate
Tap Step 1 [One-tap pause all] to stop background activity of all the apps you installed. It leaves out system apps, this app, and keyboard, home screen, message and phone apps. This makes the phone a little lighter. (Temporary measure)

Step 2 Delete
- After pausing, tap [Choose apps to delete] in the dialog and suspicious apps are pre-checked.
- Uncheck apps you use (tap an app to see the reasons)
- Tap [Step 2 ▸ Delete selected apps], then tap [OK] in the confirmation window shown for each app
- If strange ads keep appearing, follow [Clean up ads and algorithm]

Good to know
- This is not antivirus. It has no malware database and judges only by signs.
- An app with signs can still be a normal app. Delete only apps you don't recognize.
- Verdict names: Permission-grabbing / Ad-flooding / Abandoned / Same-gang (same developer) / Install-helper / Fake tool or scare app. If two or more reasons overlap, it is [Suspicious].
- An app you opened yourself within the last 7 days is moved down to [Likely safe]. (When usage access is turned on)
- If you turn on [More > New app instant analysis alerts], the analysis result pops up as a notification as soon as a new app is installed. Tap it to open the analysis popup and delete right away. ('Watching' stays in the notification shade, and because it may be turned off by battery saving, a helper that checks every 15 minutes is also turned on)
- In [More > Notification cleanup], clear built-up notifications by app, and go straight to the notification settings of apps that keep notifying you to turn them off.
- [More > Emergency guide] has the steps for Safe Mode and more when the phone freezes.
- Check apps you know are safe and tap [Mark as safe] to remove them from the list, pause and delete.
- In [Storage manager] you can clean up duplicate photos and videos and duplicate contacts. (Permission is requested only when needed)
- If the home screen (launcher) has been changed, a red notice appears at the top. Use [Restore default home screen] to choose the default home app again in settings. (The app cannot change it for you)
- Apps that came with the phone (factory-installed) are left out of the suspicious list.
- Pause is a temporary measure that stops background activity. The app may start again, and the app currently on screen may not be stoppable.
- It never deletes apps secretly. Deletion is always done by you in the confirmation window.
- Scan results (app lists, photos, contacts, etc.) are never sent out. The internet is used only for sign-in, family connection and screen sharing.
- This is a free tool made by an individual; judgment and responsibility rest with the user.


[New in v2: Family connection and screen help]
- Sign in under [More > Family connection & screen help] (Korea: Kakao, Naver, Google / elsewhere: Google). All basic scanning features work without signing in.
- The person being helped taps [Create invite code] to get a 8-digit code and QR (10 minutes, single use). When the helping family member enters the code or scans the QR, a request is sent, and the connection starts only when the other person taps [Accept].
- Only the person being helped can remove or block a connection. The helper can only send a [Request disconnection].
- When the helper taps [Ask to see their screen], a large [Allow / Deny] screen appears on the other phone. The screen is sent only if they allow it; while sharing, 'Your screen is being shared' stays in the top notification and they can end it anytime with [Stop] (it ends automatically after 15 minutes).
- The screen is not recorded or stored and goes straight to the other person only. The helper cannot operate your phone; if they tap the video, a circle appears on your screen, and if they tap a preset phrase button, a large-text message appears briefly.
- If a bank, police, prosecutor or stranger asks you to share your screen, it is a voice-phishing scam. Allow it only for a family member you asked for help.
- Requesting screen help requires the helper's monthly subscription (free for the person being helped, and the basic scanner is free too). Family designated by the operator use it free.
- In [Screen sharing history] you can see only who, when and for how long (deleted automatically after 90 days), and the person being helped can delete it themselves.

What does this app do?
It scans the apps installed on your phone and shows signs that are common in apps installed through ads (source, install time, risky permissions, and so on).

How to use it
When the phone is too slow to operate
Tap Step 1 [One-tap pause all] to stop background activity of all the apps you installed. It leaves out system apps, this app, and keyboard, home screen, message and phone apps. This makes the phone a little lighter. (Temporary measure)

Step 2 Delete
- After pausing, tap [Choose apps to delete] in the dialog and suspicious apps are pre-checked.
- Uncheck apps you use (tap an app to see the reasons)
- Tap [Step 2 ▸ Delete selected apps], then tap [OK] in the confirmation window shown for each app
- If strange ads keep appearing, follow [Clean up ads and algorithm]

Good to know
- This is not antivirus. It has no malware database and judges only by signs.
- An app with signs can still be a normal app. Delete only apps you don't recognize.
- Verdict names: Permission-grabbing / Ad-flooding / Abandoned / Same-gang (same developer) / Install-helper / Fake tool or scare app. If two or more reasons overlap, it is [Suspicious].
- If you turn on [More > New app install alerts], the analysis result pops up as a notification within 15 minutes after a new app is installed. Tap it to open the analysis screen and delete right away. (It cannot block the installation)
- In [More > Notification cleanup], go straight to the notification settings of apps that keep notifying you and turn them off.
- [More > Emergency guide] has the steps for Safe Mode and more when the phone freezes.
- Check apps you know are safe and tap [Mark as safe] to remove them from the list, pause and delete.
- In [Storage manager] you can see storage usage and go to the phone's storage cleanup screen.
- If the home screen (launcher) has been changed, a red notice appears at the top. Use [Restore default home screen] to choose the default home app again in settings. (The app cannot change it for you)
- Apps that came with the phone (factory-installed) are left out of the suspicious list.
- Pause is a temporary measure that stops background activity. The app may start again, and the app currently on screen may not be stoppable.
- It never deletes apps secretly. Deletion is always done by you in the confirmation window.
- Scan results (app lists, photos, contacts, etc.) are never sent out. The internet is used only for sign-in, family connection and screen sharing.
- This is a free tool made by an individual; judgment and responsibility rest with the user.


[New in v2: Family connection and screen help]
- Sign in under [More > Family connection & screen help] (Korea: Kakao, Naver, Google / elsewhere: Google). All basic scanning features work without signing in.
- The person being helped taps [Create invite code] to get a 8-digit code and QR (10 minutes, single use). When the helping family member enters the code or scans the QR, a request is sent, and the connection starts only when the other person taps [Accept].
- Only the person being helped can remove or block a connection. The helper can only send a [Request disconnection].
- When the helper taps [Ask to see their screen], a large [Allow / Deny] screen appears on the other phone. The screen is sent only if they allow it; while sharing, 'Your screen is being shared' stays in the top notification and they can end it anytime with [Stop] (it ends automatically after 15 minutes).
- The screen is not recorded or stored and goes straight to the other person only. The helper cannot operate your phone; if they tap the video, a circle appears on your screen, and if they tap a preset phrase button, a large-text message appears briefly.
- If a bank, police, prosecutor or stranger asks you to share your screen, it is a voice-phishing scam. Allow it only for a family member you asked for help.
- Requesting screen help requires the helper's monthly subscription (free for the person being helped, and the basic scanner is free too). Family designated by the operator use it free.
- In [Screen sharing history] you can see only who, when and for how long (deleted automatically after 90 days), and the person being helped can delete it themselves.
- Languages: 한국어 · English · 日本語 · Español · Português · Bahasa Indonesia · हिन्दी (More > Language)
